text: 虽然你想买下这对奇怪的陶土圆筒，但有人出了更高的价。你听见沃伦先生宣布“阿瑟·邓肯”，并看见那对穿深色西装的男人中一人上前领走物品。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 73
text: Though you wished to buy the curious clay cylinders, someone else placed a higher bid. You hear Mr. Warren announce the name “Arthur Duncan” and see one of the dark-suited pair approach to take the item from him.
